name: graphify
description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
one_liner: Maps a messy codebase — code, docs, database schemas, PDFs — into a navigable map of how everything connects, so you can ask questions about it instead of grepping through files for hours.
buyer: An engineering manager who just inherited a legacy codebase (via acquisition or a departed team) and needs new hires to understand it in days, not months.
business_use_cases: A dev consultancy runs it on a new client's undocumented legacy system during the first week of an engagement to scope the work accurately before quoting a price.
A new engineering hire at a startup uses it to self-onboard onto a large codebase without waiting weeks for a senior engineer's time.
A due-diligence firm evaluating a startup acquisition runs it to quickly assess codebase complexity and technical debt before the deal closes.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid 'codebase comprehension' reports for M&A technical due diligence, generated in hours instead of the weeks a manual audit takes.
The project's own cloud tier (Graphify Cloud) already monetizes always-on, cross-repo graphs via subscription; a reseller could bundle it with onboarding consulting.

steal_this: Offer a fixed-price 'understand this codebase in 48 hours' service for startups about to onboard a contractor or new hire, using this tool to generate the map and a plain-English walkthrough doc.
